sentences.en: Sami decorated the place in his distinctive style.
sentences.zh: 萨米用他独特的风格装饰了这个地方。

sentences.en: The distinctive colouring of the flamingo comes from carotenoids in their diet.
sentences.zh: 火烈鸟那与众不同的色彩来自它们饮食中的类胡萝卜素。

sentences.en: Progress, man’s distinctive mark alone, Not God’s, and not the beasts’.
sentences.zh: 进步是人类独有的标志，不是神的，也不是动物的。
